sanskrit_verse: चोदना प्रतिकालं च युक्तिलेशस तथैव च । तृतीयः शपथश चोक्तस तैर एवं साधयेत क्रमात् ॥
transliteration: codanā pratikālaṃ ca yuktileśas tathaiva ca | tṛtīyaḥ śapathaś coktas tair evaṃ sādhayet kramāt ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Directive impulse, timely response, and minimal reasoning—these three constitute the sequential foundation by which all dharmic completion is accomplished.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from directive cognition, not coercive power.
Causation aligns with conscious responsiveness, not mechanical reaction.
Capacity-based responsibility arises through alignment with dharma's timing.
Restoration logic operates through ordered completion, not punitive reversal.
Consciousness alignment is achieved via sequential manifestation of intent.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being receives a codanā (directive impulse) AND responds within pratikāla (appropriate time), THEN capacity for dharmic action is affirmed.
IF yukti (reasoning) exceeds necessary scope in judgment, THEN decision-making integrity is compromised.
IF śapatha (truth affirmation) is invoked without causal clarity, THEN reintegration protocol initiates automatically.
ALL adjudicative sequences MUST follow the triadic order: codanā → pratikāla → yuktileśa.
NO punitive measure shall interrupt the completion process initiated by śapatha.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this triadic sequence determines jurisdictional validity. Only those cases where codanā has been properly received, pratikāla observed, and yuktileśa applied shall proceed. The court functions as facilitator of completion, ensuring alignment with cosmic order rather than enforcing human constructs.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here denotes pramāṇa-grounded unfolding. Each step—anupūrvaśaḥ—must manifest fully before proceeding. Responsibility is proportional to awareness at each stage. There is no punishment because error is viewed as incomplete manifestation requiring guided realignment, not retribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate codanā resonance protocol to restore lost directive clarity.
Activate pratikāla calibration mechanism to realign temporal responsiveness.
Deploy yuktileśa refinement process to eliminate excessive rationalization.
Engage śapatha anchoring ritual to reaffirm truth-consciousness connection.
Execute sequential completion cycle until full dharma alignment is restored.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: justice is completion, not condemnation; consciousness is the ultimate judge, and dharma flows unbroken through the perfected sequence of knowing, responding, and realizing.
